feature_contract.goal: Restore complete 32-bit opaque XRGB DDS upload compatibility for car-select/menu sprites through original decoder/VR renderer, preserving A8 alpha and original game texture fallbacks.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only DDS format recognition, opaque B8->R8 conversion and existing UI native/original fallback; no changes to race world, UI placement, input, shadows, SkyGlow, FFB or DXVK.
trace_stages: Game vehicle/menu DDS opaque 32bpp RGB masks and selected replacement data
D3DX fast DDS image format and per-mip upload, with MANAGED LockRect or native D3DX fallback
Vehicle-select sprite rendering/theater host transfer retaining texture color and alpha semantics
subcomponents: Recognize both 32-bit opaque DDS mask orders separately from A8
Normalize X8B8 to supported X8R8 and swizzle every packed mip row with pitch safety
Preserve invalid/unsupported DDS original D3DX fallback, Reset/desktop and A8 alpha rendering

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Opaque DDS RGB masks both accepted, B8 order swizzled per level with unchanged X8 texture type
A8 alpha, source bounds, pitch, replacement/native/original fallback and transparent UI preserved; negative mutations caught
Exact SHA DX9Ex Active host/game/package, Domain and Full Source Impact succeed; Quest3 car-select white-box optical acceptance separate

diagnosis.original_evidence: User reports white/missing vehicle-selection textures; currently built-in fast decoder has no branch for legal 32-bit XRGB DDS without alpha mask.
diagnosis.bounded_cause: Opaque X8R8G8B8 and X8B8G8R8 RGB DDS were returned UNKNOWN, so fast upload skipped; native D3DX retry was the only path for these formats. Whether this is the Quest3 white-box root cause is NOT YET proven.
alternatives_rejected: Do not reclassify vehicle-select preview as gameplay stereo or modify camera/host composition without evidence.
Do not convert X8 to A8 or globally change sampler state; preserve ordinary A8 sprites and replacement-to-original fallback.
source_trace: DDS pixel mask recognition in GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat
D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx_Custom first mip and subsequent mip pitched copy
UI custom/native D3DX fallback and original DDS scale/header recovery
Existing vehicle-select theater rendering and host copy
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Texture decode/source only; does not modify stereo ownership.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing HUD DDS mutation verifier extended for no-alpha XRGB masks, destination format and both channel-swap writes.

validation_notes: GitHub commit prepared without moving target ref while earlier 00779 DX9Ex Active CI is in progress. Exact-SHA validation and Quest3 test pending. Do not mark whole optical defect fixed from this code path alone.
